==Description==
The '''Burnt Gingerbread''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Village of Despair]] as part of the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. It had the same speed as the [[Gingerbread (Village of Despair)|Gingerbread]], though it had less health. However, the main threat of the '''Burnt Gingerbread''' was that it was able to throw fireballs at towers. This stunned the tower for a lengthy period of time when hit, allowing other enemies to get past. It was also a hidden enemy.

The '''Burnt Gingerbread''' could have been spawned by [[Krampus (Village of Despair)|Krampus]].

==Appearance==
The '''Burnt Gingerbread''' took a similar appearance to the [[Gingerbread (Village of Despair)|Gingerbread]], though the '''Burnt Gingerbread''' was more burnt (or darker). It had glowing red eyes, frosting buttons and a frosting smile. The '''Burnt Gingerbread''' was set alight with a yellow flame.

==Strategy==
*Because the '''Burnt Gingerbread''' targets a random tower in its range, it may be wise to deploy a cheap tower, like the [[Scout]], to distract the '''Gingerbread''' away from your main towers.
*The [[Pyromancer]] cannot slow the '''Burnt Gingerbread''' down (or target it) as it is immune to burn.
**If you want to slow the '''Burnt Gingerbread''', then you can use the [[Freezer]] or [[Frost Blaster]].
*Multiple '''Burnt Gingerbreads''' tend to throw their fireballs at one tower. This stuns the affected tower for a very long time as the stuns stack up.
**If the tower is important to your survival, it may be best to just sell it and replace it, saving a lot of time.
*As '''Burnt Gingerbreads''' are hidden enemies, you will need [[Ranger|Outlaws]] or a couple of Level 2 [[Minigunner]]s to deal with them.
**For cheap hidden detection, a Level 2 [[Soldier]] provides decent defense.

==Trivia==
*The '''Burnt Gingerbread''' may be based on the [[w:c:r2da:Christmas Costumes 2018|Christmas 2018]] [[w:c:r2da:Elemental|Elemental]] from ''R2DA''.
**Additionally, when the '''Burnt Gingerbread''' used its ''Fireball'' ability, it made the same noise (albeit lower pitched) as the [[w:c:r2da:Gingerbread Minion|Gingerbread Minion]]'s pain sound.
*The head used for the '''Burnt Gingerbread''' was a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|42588770|Gingerbread Man Head}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
